name: University of Bonn
description: The Rheinische Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn is a public research university in Bonn, North Rhine-Westphalia, founded in 1818. It has around 35,000 students and is one of Germany's universities of excellence.
whyIncluded: The University of Bonn is an NUS Student Exchange Programme partner, so NUS undergraduates can spend a semester studying in Bonn.

livingCosts.summary: The University of Bonn's own 'Costs' page lists average monthly student spending in Bonn: rent, food, transport, and a personal line covering phone, leisure, study materials and clothing. Excludes health costs and the semester fee, which includes the Deutschland semester ticket.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. University of Bonn 'Costs' page, table 'Living expenses' ('Average monthly living expenses in Bonn total:'), which the page attributes to the 22nd DSW/DZHW Social Survey (2023). Lines used verbatim: Rent 410, Food 198, Transportation (car) 89, Health care costs 100, Communication 31, Leisure 65, Learning material 31, Clothing 46. Derivation: housing = 410; food = 198; transport = 89 (the page's own transport line; note most students actually travel on the Deutschlandsemesterticket inside the semester fee); personal = 31 + 65 + 31 + 46 = 173 (the 'Health care costs 100' line, the survey's health insurance and medical line, is excluded as HU Berlin's record does). Monthly total 870. Excluded: semester fee / social contribution EUR 363.07 for winter 2026/27 (of which Deutschlandsemesterticket 226.80) and 345.07 for summer 2026. The page gives no separate health-insurance premium; the 'Health care costs' line is the only health item. The international-students page ('Costs and Financing for International Students') gives only a single total of roughly EUR 1,000/month and the EUR 992/month visa proof-of-funds figure, consistent with this table. Bug fix 2026-10-14: health insurance taken out of the personal line, as the schema keeps insurance out of living costs.

programmes.name: Informatik (Computer Science) B.Sc.
programmes.feeBasis: Bonn charges no tuition for any degree; the figure is just the winter 2026/27 semester contribution of EUR 363.07 x 2 semesters, the same for every programme.
programmes.summary: No tuition, including for international students. The figure is only the compulsory semester contribution, which includes a Germany-wide transport ticket. Taught in German.
programmes.notes: No tuition fees: the University of Bonn's 'Costs' page states that as a public university it does not charge tuition (North Rhine-Westphalia charges none, including for non-EU students). Compulsory fees = semester contribution for winter semester 2026/27, stated total EUR 363.07 x2 = 726.14. Items listed: student self-administration 14.00, social services 0.50, student councils 2.25, support fund 0.01, university sports 0.80, culture pass 3.00, Deutschlandsemesterticket 226.80, mobility refund account 0.01, Studierendenwerk 115.00; these sum to 362.37, EUR 0.70 below the stated total (re-read 2026-10-07; the stated total is used). 2025 history: the same page gives summer semester 2026 (part of academic year 2025/26) as EUR 345.07, identical except the ticket at 208.80, so 690.14; the winter 2025/26 rate is not published there, so the summer rate x2 is used (as for HU Berlin). No 2024 figure found (Bonn's 2024 finance flyer only says 'ca. 345 EUR'). Language of instruction German: the Institute of Computer Science's bachelor's page says 'All the Bachelor programs are offered in German' (informatik.uni-bonn.de/en/studies/bachelor-programs). Standard period 6 semesters (usual Bonn B.Sc.; not read from the programme page). On 2026-10-13 also checked Bonn's Rueckmeldung page (no amount), the student parliament's Beitragsordnung (only WS 2026/27-SS 2027: 248.07 student-body share) and the ULB e-Pflicht official-notice PDFs (those found were Hochschule Bonn-Rhein-Sieg and RWTH, not Uni Bonn): no dated 2024/25 total found. Round 2 (2026-10-13): searches for a dated Uni Bonn WS 2024/25 or SS 2025 semester contribution (AStA Bonn, Bonn epflicht notices, news) found only Hochschule Bonn-Rhein-Sieg figures, so no 2024 row. Round 3 (2026-10-13): the Bonn student-body Beitragsordnung amendments on epflicht.ulb.uni-bonn.de found by search cover only WS 2020/21-SS 2022 (BOAeO XXXII, XXXIII), and they exclude the Studierendenwerk share, so no 2024 row. Round 5 (2026-10-13): found Uni Bonn's Amtliche Bekanntmachungen on epflicht.ulb.uni-bonn.de (periodical/structure/4586; needs cookie js_enabled=1). XXXIX. BOÄO (Amtl. Bek. 2/2025, 29.01.2025): student-body contribution 'Der Beitrag in Höhe von 198,16 € für das Wintersemester 2024/25 und 197,67 € für das Sommersemester 2025'; Achte Ordnung zur Änderung der Beitragsordnung des Studierendenwerks Bonn (Amtl. Bek. 20/2024): Studierendenwerk contribution 'ab dem Wintersemester 2024/25 auf einhundertundfünfzehn Euro' (EUR 115, unchanged through 2026). 2024 row = (198.16+115) + (197.67+115) = 313.16 + 312.67 = 625.83 (sum of the two officially published components per semester). Also confirmed: XL. BOÄO (Amtl. Bek. 28/2025) sets 230.07 for both WS 2025/26 and SS 2026, so WS 2025/26 total = 345.07 and the 2025 row (690.14) is exact.
